goal: Determine the smallest owner-preserving ontology and executable runtime architecture for Whisper, and define how a candidate demonstrator can begin inside projects/co-op-engine without moving canonical Whisper meaning or runtime authority out of Arcanum. Produce an exact-binding design and implementation handoff, not an ontology implementation or runtime claim.
context: Whisper already has a governed intent-to-text lifecycle, a candidate YAML-native substrate contract, generated Codex runtime prose, deterministic draft validation, typed editorial receipts, and a final-status ceiling evaluator. The co-op-engine surface currently presents Whisper as a public portfolio project and describes a future story knowledge graph, but it is a static site rather than a Whisper application runtime. Research must separate canonical ontology ownership, executable lifecycle orchestration, evidence and human gates, and a candidate co-op-engine adapter; it may inspect and recommend, but it may not edit product code, admit ontology relations, register authority, deploy, publish, or claim production readiness.
anti_bias_global: Semantic completeness and ownership versus executable runtime minimality, followed by independent precedent, non-vacuity, and definitional non-collapse attacks.

groups.anti_bias: Composite methodology and source-corpus axis: formal ontology and constraint modeling versus empirical and computational runtime architecture.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs formal ontology and constraint modeling over Whisper concepts, relations, evidence, and external primary standards while agent 1 runs empirical and computational runtime tracing over current validators, generated adapters, orchestration precedents, and the co-op-engine seam on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a bias in agent 0 toward semantically complete but inert modeling would be exposed by agent 1, while a bias in agent 1 toward executable minimality without stable meaning or owner boundaries would be exposed by agent 0.

agents.angle: Formal ontology and constraint-model lane over Whisper's artifact lifecycle, narrative/story entities, evidence axes, human gates, and authority boundaries.
agents.initial_prompt: Work from /home/vrondelli/projects/domainspec-core as a read-only research seat. Design the evidence base for a candidate Whisper ontology without creating or promoting it. Inspect the current canonical Whisper README, development design, text-intent substrate contract, editorial-run receipt schema, relevant fixtures, review-surface contract, and the #project-whisper co-op-engine card. Treat the Inventory packet only as discovery: independently verify the direct sources behind the ontology-operationalization and ontology-working-prototype entries. Search external precedent using primary standards, official specifications, or original papers only, covering semantic graphs, constraint validation, provenance, narrative/story modeling, and human/editorial evidence where material. Produce: (1) a concept/relation/constraint inventory with exact source selectors; (2) candidate node, relation, event, state, evidence, and receipt kinds; (3) authored versus derived versus observed versus approved boundaries; (4) closed-world validation slices and abstention cases; (5) public Arcanum versus private/candidate co-op-engine ownership; (6) a five-to-ten-node minimum finite witness with positive, negative, indeterminate, and denied-authority cases; (7) precedent disposition as build-from-owned, already-deployed, or precedent-clean only after actual search; and (8) open owner decisions. Every load-bearing row must include immutable source identity, exact selector or structured pointer, evidence scope, explorer-return reference, and observed, executed, or unverified status. Do not edit files, admit definitions, relations, ontology authority, or promotion. Return a structured exact-binding receipt and concise research narrative. Output target about 4600 tokens.

agents.angle: Executable runtime and co-op-engine adapter lane over lifecycle state, commands/events, validators, human gates, receipts, replay, and failure recovery.

Produce: (1) current runtime capability and gap matrix; (2) proposed command, event, state, artifact, receipt, and projection contracts; (3) a thin co-op-engine candidate adapter that cannot own canonical Whisper meaning or lifecycle authority; (4) process and storage options with select/narrow/defer/kill dispositions; (5) one finite end-to-end run from intent intake through plan, audition, draft, validation, correction, and residue; (6) negative, retry, replay, stale-digest, missing-human-evidence, and denied-effect witnesses; (7) exact validation commands and required receipts for a later prototype; and (8) open owner and technology decisions. Return synthesis and a structured receipt only; do not write repository files. Output target about 5600 tokens.

groups.anti_bias: Attack-vector axis: precedent and owner duplication, non-vacuity and finite execution witness, and definitional plus authority non-collapse.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs a precedent and owner-duplication attack while agent 1 runs a non-vacuity attack using finite ontology-plus-runtime witnesses on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward correct ownership without proving usefulness would be exposed by agent 1, while a bias in agent 1 toward a bespoke working demo that duplicates an existing owner would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 0 classifies existing ontology, workflow, validation, evidence, and deployment owners while agent 2 runs a definitional and authority non-collapse attack on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward reusing an owned surface under the wrong meaning would be exposed by agent 2, while a bias in agent 2 toward rejecting compatible reuse because names differ would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 1 requires a finite end-to-end witness with negative, retry, replay, and human-gate cases while agent 2 requires every retained concept to preserve distinct semantic, lifecycle, evidence, approval, adapter, and deployment authority on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 1 toward a persuasive but authority-collapsing runtime would be exposed by agent 2, while a bias in agent 2 toward a perfectly separated but operationally empty taxonomy would be exposed by agent 1.

agents.angle: Precedent gate: locate the actual owner and reusable precedent for every proposed ontology, runtime, evidence, adapter, and deployment responsibility.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only precedent, ownership, and duplication in the synthesized Whisper ontology/runtime model. Verify direct current repository sources and the explorers' primary external sources rather than Inventory summaries. For every proposed concept, relation, validator, lifecycle transition, workflow component, receipt, projection, human gate, co-op-engine adapter, or storage role, identify the current owner and classify already-implemented, build-from-owned, proposal-only, owner-conflict, or precedent-clean only after a bounded actual search. Being owned is never itself a KILL. Require a public/private disposition and distinguish canonical Arcanum from candidate co-op-engine material. Return PASS or exact repairs with source identities, selectors, and owner consequences. Do not edit files. Output target about 2800 tokens.

agents.angle: Non-vacuity gate: force the proposed ontology and runtime through a finite discriminating story-composition witness and failure cases.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only non-vacuity. Require one finite ontology-plus-runtime fixture that begins with raw author intent and reaches an evidence-bounded draft/residue outcome through explicit commands, events, states, artifacts, validation, human approval or comprehension where required, correction, replay, and projection. Require negative cases for invalid graph direction, missing relation owner, stale artifact or surface digest, volatile-intent derivative fan-out, missing human evidence, repeated command, interrupted run, and attempted co-op-engine or ontology authority write. For each step name the exact current component that executes it, the proposed component that is absent, the receipt needed, and the expected pass/flag/block or indeterminate result. KILL any retained claim with no distinct witness or counterexample. Return PASS or exact repairs; make no file changes and do not execute external effects. Output target about 3200 tokens.

agents.angle: Definitional and authority gate: prevent story-world meaning, composition lifecycle, runtime orchestration, evidence, approval, and public demonstration from collapsing.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only definitional soundness and authority non-collapse. Test every retained noun and relation against at least these distinctions: canonical concept versus candidate instance; author intent versus story-world fact; artifact versus state; command versus event; authored versus derived versus observed versus approved; validation result versus editorial judgment; editorial approval versus comprehension; evidence versus authority; runtime lifecycle versus co-op-engine adapter; projection versus source; generated skill projection versus canonical spell; prototype reachability versus deployment or production. Require a unique meaning, owner, input, output, failure mode, and forbidden substitution for each retained type and edge. Return KEEP, MERGE, RENAME, DEFER, or KILL and PASS only if the repaired vocabulary remains operationally non-vacuous. Do not edit files. Output target about 3200 tokens.
